name: axin 1

function.text: AXIN1 encodes axin-1. Annotated molecular activities include molecular adaptor activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in cell development and protein-containing complex assembly.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Hepatocellular carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.

function.text: AXIN1 encodes axin-1. It participates in cell development and protein-containing complex assembly. Functional annotations also associate the protein with molecular adaptor activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AXIN1 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma and glioblastoma multiforme.
